Maya: focus: cost predictability, production latency, and operational fallbacks. one-liners + single proof sentence each.
Connor: zingers: 
- "No surprise token billsE28094reserve inference, stabilize spend." Proof: "Customers see 2-3x reduction in token cost variance with Dedicated."

- "Turnkey rollouts and fallbacks." Proof: "Canary + auto-fallback templates cut ops time-to-safe-rollout to days."
Dee: email subjects: A: "Demo: stabilize LLM latency + costs" B: "How teams reduced inference spend 3x (no retrain)"

- "Cloud endpoints are fine for prototypes; at scale you want pinned capacity."
- "We serve verified perf profiles so you know unit cost before you ship."
OpsBot: created tracker PRJ-6401: https://rwd-internal/track/PRJ-6401 :white_check_mark:
Eli: routing rules to test: webinar signups where company_size>500 -> sales-dedicated; demos with tag:compliance -> sales-enterprise; others -> marketing-nurture.
Maya: slide soundbites: 
- "Reserve capacity, avoid billing surprises."

- "Built-in rollouts & fallbacks."
Connor: I'll upload a short p95 chart and token-econ snapshot to PRJ-6401 by EOD. Dee: I'll draft SDR email copy and post here. Reconvene tomorrow 11am to finalize. :rocket:
